description: Trafikregelföreteelser - NVDB is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lantmäteriet. Events from the National Road Database (NVDB) for the entire road network: - Limited gross weight - Limited vehicle width - Limited vehicle length - Restricted axle - bogie pressure - Carrying capacity - Circulation site - Prohibited direction of travel - Prohibited turn - Traffic ban - Pedestrian Street & Walking Area - Speed ... Coverage: SE. The portal shows the English title as "Traffic regulations - NVDB" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Vägdata, Road data. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
